flux1_schnell.label: FLUX.1 [schnell]
flux1_schnell.description: Fast text-to-image by Black Forest Labs. 1-4 step generation, Apache 2.0 licensed.

invoke.prompt_guidance:
FLUX.1 schnell uses natural language — write like describing a photograph or painting.
Structure: Subject first → Action/Pose → Environment → Lighting → Camera → Style.
Front-load the most important elements (the model pays more attention to what comes first).
DO NOT use negative prompts or 'no/not/without' — instead describe what you WANT.
Medium length works best (30-80 words). Be specific: '85mm lens, f/1.4' not 'nice photo'.
Use cinematic terms: 'golden hour lighting', 'Rembrandt lighting', 'shallow depth of field'.
Quality markers: 'professional photography', 'cinematic', 'highly detailed', '8k'.

flux1_dev.label: FLUX.1 [dev]
flux1_dev.description: High-quality text-to-image by Black Forest Labs. Non-commercial license. Slow on 24GB GPU (sequential CPU offload).

invoke.prompt_guidance:
FLUX.1 dev is a 12B parameter model with exceptional prompt following.
Use natural language — write like describing a photograph or painting.
Structure: Subject first → Action/Pose → Environment → Lighting → Camera → Style.
Front-load the most important elements (the model pays more attention to what comes first).
DO NOT use negative prompts or 'no/not/without' — instead describe what you WANT.
Replace 'no crowds' with 'peaceful solitude'. Replace 'without glasses' with 'clear eyes'.
Medium-long prompts work best (40-100 words). Be specific and descriptive.
Camera/lens specs are very effective: '85mm lens, f/1.4, shallow depth of field'.
Lighting descriptions matter: 'golden hour', 'Rembrandt lighting', 'soft diffused light'.
Artistic references work well: 'in the style of Greg Rutkowski', 'Miyazaki-inspired'.
Quality markers: 'professional photography', 'cinematic quality', 'highly detailed', '8k resolution'.

flux2_dev.label: FLUX.2 [dev]
flux2_dev.description: 32B parameter flagship by Black Forest Labs. State-of-the-art quality with text rendering, reference editing. Non-commercial.

invoke.prompt_guidance:
FLUX.2 dev is a 32B parameter model — the most capable open-source image generator.
Use natural language — write like describing a photograph, painting, or cinematic shot.
Structure: Subject first → Action/Pose → Environment → Lighting → Camera → Style.
Front-load the most important elements (the model pays more attention to what comes first).
DO NOT use negative prompts or 'no/not/without' — describe what you WANT instead.
FLUX.2 excels at: text rendering in images, character consistency, multi-reference editing.
Longer prompts work well (50-120 words) — the model has exceptional prompt following.
Camera specs: '85mm lens, f/1.4', 'wide-angle 24mm', 'aerial drone shot'.
Lighting: 'golden hour', 'studio lighting', 'dramatic chiaroscuro', 'neon-lit'.
Quality: 'professional photography', 'cinematic', '8k resolution', 'award-winning'.
Can render readable text in images — include exact text in quotes if needed.

sdxl_turbo.label: SDXL Turbo
sdxl_turbo.description: Ultra-fast 1-step image generation by Stability AI.

invoke.prompt_guidance:
SDXL Turbo generates in 1 step — prompts must be clear and direct.
Use SDXL-style keyword prompting: comma-separated descriptors.
Quality boosters are essential: 'masterpiece, best quality, highly detailed'.
Style tokens work well: 'digital painting', 'concept art', 'photorealistic'.
Keep prompts concise (20-50 words) — quality over quantity for 1-step generation.
Negative prompts ARE supported and very effective for cleanup.
Common useful negatives: 'blurry, low quality, deformed, ugly, bad anatomy, watermark'.
Default resolution is 512×512. Higher resolutions may reduce quality.
